The '''Sepan system''', also known as the '''Dimok system''',<ref name="CSWE-Youst" /> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sepan sector/Legends|Sepan sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Description==
{{Quote|The civil war that has ravaged your planets is over. It is time to lay down your arms. Join us, to rebuild all that was destroyed in this savage conflict. Even now, the process of repairing your planets has begun.|[[Harkov]]|audio=HarkovSpeech-TF.flac|<ref name="TF" />}}
The Sepan [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Dimok/Legends|Dimok]],<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Gaerboud IV]],<ref name="XWvTF" /><ref name="Email 2" /> [[Gerbaud 2]],<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Kuthard]],<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="Email" /> [[Ripoblus/Legends|Ripoblus]] and [[Sepan 8]].<ref name="CSWE" /> It was also the site of the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] [[Sentinel (Deep Space Manufacturing Facility)|Sentinel]]<ref name="XWvTF" /><ref name="Email 2" /> and the [[XQ1 Platform]] [[Science Station Youst|Youst]].<ref name="CSWE-Youst" />

The Sepan system was home to the eponymous [[Sepan]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="TFCCD:TOSG" /> [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]<ref name="TF" /> divided between the peoples of Dimok and Ripoblus,<ref name="TFCCD:TOSG" /> the two primary worlds of the system.<ref name="CSWE-Dimok">{{CSWECite|I|189|Dimok}}</ref><ref name="CSWE-Ripoblus">{{CSWECite|III|101|Ripoblus}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Now we have reports of fighting breaking out on Ripoblus.''"<br />"''Why? Nobody in the Sepan system has any interest in the Confederation. I've had no intelligence&mdash;''"<br />"''They don't need any love for either cause. We've reached the free-for-all stage. What better time than during a civil war to resurrect their dispute with Dimok? Like a cantina brawl. One fight breaks out and everyone suddenly remembers they have a score to settle.|[[Cal Omas]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Cha Niathal]]|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
The Sepan system was the site of the [[Sepan Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Dimok (people)|Dimoks]] and the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] which lasted intermittently for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="HNN" /><ref name="TF" /><ref name="Sacrifice" /><ref name="TEGtW" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', confirmed in [[June]] [[2015]] that Kuthard was a planet located in the Sepan system.<ref name="Email" /> Fry also confirmed in [[April]] [[2023]] that Gaerboud IV was located in the Sepan system.<ref name="Email 2" />
